tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Palette.Primary → --mud-palette-primary. The main action on a screen (Export MP4, Add, Connect), the selected filter chip, active toggles, the focus ring and progress. Text-safe on every ground (≥ 5.0:1 on `surface`, 4.3:1 on `surface-raised`, so icons only there).

tokens.name: primary-contrast-text
tokens.usage: Palette.PrimaryContrastText → --mud-palette-primary-text. Label and icon on a `primary` fill (6.9:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Palette.Secondary. Network series in Stats for nerds, the Processing status and the export progress bar.

tokens.name: secondary-contrast-text
tokens.usage: Palette.SecondaryContrastText (10.5:1).

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Palette.Tertiary. The stream itself: the viewer-count chart in Stats for nerds, chapter offsets and chapter ticks on the seek bar, so these read apart from playback (`primary`) and network (`secondary`).

tokens.name: tertiary-contrast-text
tokens.usage: Palette.TertiaryContrastText (6.5:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Palette.Info. Info alerts (the plain-HTTP note on Settings, the coverage note). Always with the info icon.

tokens.name: info-contrast-text
tokens.usage: Palette.InfoContrastText (8.1:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Palette.Success. Connected and healthy: the Twitch account dot, Healthy service, full coverage. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: success-contrast-text
tokens.usage: Palette.SuccessContrastText (9.6:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Palette.Warning. Partial captures, reconnecting, low disk, polling fallback.

tokens.name: warning-contrast-text
tokens.usage: Palette.WarningContrastText (10.1:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Palette.Error. Failures and destructive actions (Delete, Stop recording, failed segment loads). Always with the warning icon or a word. Text on `background`, `drawer-background` and `surface` (≥ 5.2:1); on `surface-raised` icons only (4.4:1).

tokens.name: error-contrast-text
tokens.usage: Palette.ErrorContrastText. Label on a filled Delete or Stop button (7.1:1).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Palette.Background, MudBlazor's own dark default. The page behind the main column.

tokens.name: background-gray
tokens.usage: Palette.BackgroundGray. The ground behind the player column in theater mode, darker than the page so the player stands out.

tokens.name: appbar-background
tokens.usage: Palette.AppbarBackground, MudBlazor's dark default. The top app bar: flat, set off by a `divider` hairline.

tokens.name: appbar-text
tokens.usage: Palette.AppbarText. Wordmark and icons in the app bar.

tokens.name: drawer-background
tokens.usage: Palette.DrawerBackground, MudBlazor's dark default. The library drawer.

tokens.name: drawer-text
tokens.usage: Palette.DrawerText. Streamer names and recording titles in the drawer.

tokens.name: drawer-icon
tokens.usage: Palette.DrawerIcon (MudBlazor's dark ActionDefault). Chevrons and the sort icon in the drawer.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Palette.Surface, MudBlazor's dark default. MudPaper, cards, expansion panels, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: StreamKeepr addition (no Palette slot). One step above `surface`: stat tiles, the export row, thumbnail placeholders.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: StreamKeepr addition. The selected library row and the current chapter: a deep tint of `primary`. Every line on it is `text-primary` (10.9:1).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Palette.TextPrimary. Primary text and icons on every ground (≥ 9:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Palette.TextSecondary. Dates, durations, logins, stat labels, helper text: ≥ 5.3:1 on every ground, `surface-raised` included.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Palette.TextDisabled. Disabled labels (Connect Twitch to use this).

tokens.name: action-default
tokens.usage: Palette.ActionDefault, MudBlazor's dark default. Resting icon buttons.

tokens.name: action-disabled
tokens.usage: Palette.ActionDisabled, MudBlazor's dark default.

tokens.name: action-disabled-background
tokens.usage: Palette.ActionDisabledBackground, MudBlazor's dark default. Fill of a disabled filled button.

tokens.name: lines-default
tokens.usage: Palette.LinesDefault, MudBlazor's dark default. Card and panel outlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: lines-inputs
tokens.usage: Palette.LinesInputs. Text-field, outlined-button and outlined-chip borders: ≥ 3.7:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Palette.Divider, MudBlazor's dark default. Hairlines under the app bar, between drawer groups and settings rows.

tokens.name: table-lines
tokens.usage: Palette.TableLines: row rules in MudTable and MudSimpleTable (the stats key-value tables). MudBlazor 9.12.0 PaletteDark default.

tokens.name: overlay-dark
tokens.usage: Palette.OverlayDark, MudBlazor's default. The scrim behind dialogs and the temporary drawer.

styles.name: h6

styles.name: body2
styles.usage: Typography.Body2 and Typography.Default. Default UI text: menu items, search, settings values.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Typography.Button. Button labels, in sentence case: StreamKeepr sets TextTransform "none" (MudBlazor's default is uppercase).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Typography.Caption. Dates, durations, logins and helper text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Typography.Overline (uppercase). Status chips and stat-tile labels; inside a 22px chip set line-height to 16px.

groups.name: StreamKeepr additions
groups.note: Built from MudBlazor slots (same family and metrics) for roles its Typo enum lacks; apply with a class.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Caption metrics at Medium weight. Day headers in the library ("Today", "Wed, Nov 4"), filter chips, the chat sync label.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: H6 metrics at Bold. The StreamKeepr wordmark in the app bar.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Roboto with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so numbers never jitter as they update. No monospace face.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Body2 metrics, tabular figures. Player timecode, chapter offsets; 11px on thumbnail duration badges.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Body2 metrics, tabular figures. Key/value rows in the stats panel and settings; playlist URLs, codec strings.

styles.name: stat-hero
styles.usage: H5 metrics, tabular figures. Headline number on a stat tile.
